newsitem.title: CHINA: Yaohua sees continued profit fall in 1996 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Yaohua sees continued profit fall in 1996 2nd half.

text.p: Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Co Ltd expects its 1996 profits to reflect its interim results when the firm's net profits fell 61 percent from the same 1995 period, a company official said on Wednesday.
Yaohua reported interim profits of 54.8 million yuan for 1996, compared to 142.5 million yuan for the same period in 1995. Its total 1995 net profits were 263 million yuan.
The official said fierce competition continued to erode profits in the second half of 1996 and the company's plans for a third production line had been postponed.
Officials previously have said the company has suffered because competitors have emulated the advanced technology the Sino-British glassmaker built its fortunes on.
He said he expected the glass market in 1997 to be much the same as 1996.
